item.title: Nima Sand Museum: The World's Largest Hourglass — Guide
item.description: The Sand Museum at Nima, on the Sea of Japan coast, is one of Shimane’s more unusual attractions. Housed in a striking complex of glass pyramids, its centrepiece is the world’s largest hourglass — a giant sand-glass over five metres tall that takes exactly one year to run through, turned each New Year’s Eve in a public ceremony as the year changes. The museum explores sand, time and glassmaking, and there are hands-on glass-craft workshops.
